cd /private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec113/fx; S=$PWD/plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/assign-system-spec-completeness-evaluator/scripts; 
python3 $S/aggregate-completeness.py --matrix system-spec/spec-state.json --require-complete > $TMPDIR/g-matrix.json; echo m=$?
python3 $S/aggregate-completeness.py --source-citation system-spec/fetched-references.json --state system-spec/spec-state.json --repo-root $PWD > $TMPDIR/g-src.json; echo s=$?
